parameters.question: Compare Welch's t-test and Cohen's d results (Alzheimer's vs controls, n=50 each). Mean difference and Cohen's d must match within 1% relative absolute error; p-value within +/-0.001; bootstrap 95% CI bounds (10,000 iterations, seed 42) within +/-0.05; effect size label (Small/Medium/Large) must match exactly (case-insensitive). Column order and header labels may differ.
